id: title:VojtechBartos:re list tools when a gateway call names an unregistered one

review.posthog_relevance: Adds Redis-based rate limiting and failure handling to the warehouse resync path, and replaces direct database queries with re-listing helpers to recover missing tool listings. This could recover calls for an installation whose connect-time listing never landed, without requiring a manual refresh, and bounds the window of repeated handshakes.
review.reason: The change implements Redis-based rate limiting and failure handling for warehouse resync, replacing direct database queries with re-listing helpers. This could recover calls for an installation whose connect-time listing never landed, without requiring a manual refresh, and bounds the window of repeated handshakes. This is a substantive, bounded capability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The actual recovery benefit and the exact behavior of the warehouse resync path are not demonstrated by the supplied observations, which rely on unverified outcomes.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No adoption, incident, or effort claims are inferred. No tier is assigned; this chunk is not scored.

observations.behavior: Adds resync_installation_tools to the facade's tool-call path, replacing a direct database query with a re-listing helper.
observations.posthog_connection: Re-lists the upstream tool set when a tool is missing or removed, rather than refusing the call. This could recover calls for an installation whose connect-time listing never landed, without requiring a manual refresh.

observations.behavior: Adds a new helper to extract requested tool names and a re-listing path, replacing a direct query with a conditional re-listing.

observations.posthog_connection: Resync path could otherwise re-list upstream on every cache miss, potentially opening many handshakes; this bounds the window. Failure handling avoids keeping the window open after a transient fault.
